title: 🛡️ Sentinel: Add input length constraints to Pydantic models
body:
🛡️ Sentinel: [security improvement]

### 🚨 Severity: MEDIUM
### 💡 Vulnerability: Missing input length limits (DoS risk)
### 🎯 Impact: Potential Denial of Service through resource exhaustion if extremely large strings are provided in input payloads.
### 🔧 Fix: Implemented `min_length` and `max_length` constraints on Pydantic models in `templates/sqs/models.py`, `templates/stream/models.py`, `templates/eventbridge/models.py`, and `templates/s3/models.py`.
### ✅ Verification: All tests passed with `uv run pytest`.

These changes ensure that all incoming data has reasonable upper bounds, following security best practices for defense in depth.

---
